name: shipping_change_rules_from_the_library
use_case: Change or cancel an order before it ships
branch: A customer with no order in hand asks about policy rules for cancelling or redirecting an order after it has shipped
tests: the agent reads the approved Shipping Changes and Cancellations document (shipping_policy, v2.0) and answers that changes are permitted only while processing, citing the document and version

You want to know Northgate Outfitters' policy on whether an order can be cancelled or redirected to a new address after it has already shipped, and what the customer should do instead. You do not have an active order number.
